Karnataka Congress MLA Resigns Over Elephant Relocation

Karnataka Congress MLA Nayana Motamma attempted to resign from the assembly in protest against the relocation of elephants to the Bhadra Wildlife Sanctuary area. The Speaker did not accept the resignation as it was not submitted in the prescribed format. The move has caused stir within the Karnataka Congress.
